"""Plain-text absence notices for parents."""

from typing import Iterable, List

from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.attendance import days_missed


def _check_owner(student: Student, marks: List[Mark]) -> None:
    for mark in marks:
        if mark.student_id != student.student_id:
            raise ValueError(
                f"mark for {mark.student_id} does not belong "
                f"to {student.student_id}"
            )


def _compose(student: Student, dates: list) -> str:
    count = len(dates)
    unit = "day" if count == 1 else "days"
    listing = ", ".join(item.isoformat() for item in dates)
    name = f"{student.first_name} {student.last_name}"
    return f"{name} missed {count} {unit}: {listing}."


# ---
def absence_notice(student: Student, marks: Iterable[Mark]) -> str:
    marks = list(marks)
    _check_owner(student, marks)
    dates = days_missed(marks)
    if not dates:
        raise ValueError(f"no absences for {student.student_id}")
    return _compose(student, dates)
EOF
cat > tests/test_notices.py <<'EOF'
import unittest
from rosterkit.notices import absence_notice
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from datetime import date

PUPIL = Student("s1", "Lovelace", "Ada", "A")


def mark_for(owner, text, status):
    return Mark(owner, date.fromisoformat(text), status)


def two_absences():
    return [
        mark_for("s1", "2024-03-06", "absent"),
        mark_for("s1", "2024-03-04", "absent"),
        mark_for("s1", "2024-03-05", "excused")
    ]


class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_names_the_student(self):
        notice = absence_notice(PUPIL, two_absences())
        self.assertIn("Ada Lovelace", notice)

    def test_counts_the_days(self):
        notice = absence_notice(PUPIL, two_absences())
        self.assertIn("missed 2 days", notice)

    def test_dates_are_in_order(self):
        notice = absence_notice(PUPIL, two_absences())
        self.assertIn("2024-03-04, 2024-03-06", notice)

    def test_excused_day_is_left_out(self):
        notice = absence_notice(PUPIL, two_absences())
        self.assertNotIn("2024-03-05", notice)

    def test_single_day_is_singular(self):
        marks = [mark_for("s1", "2024-03-04", "absent")]
        self.assertIn("1 day:", absence_notice(PUPIL, marks))

    def test_other_students_mark_is_rejected(self):
        marks = two_absences() + [mark_for("s2", "2024-03-07", "absent")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)

    def test_no_absences_is_rejected(self):
        marks = [mark_for("s1", "2024-03-04", "present")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)
EOF
